question.text: Contra-trade restriction under PIT Regs for Designated Persons (listed securities) is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Under the PIT Regulations, the code of conduct must specify a contra-trade restriction period of not less than six months for a designated/connected person, during which a buy followed by a sell (or vice versa) is not permitted. The Trap: Shorter periods such as one or three months do not satisfy the not-less-than-six-months requirement. Note: The PM source introduces this requirement through the code applicable to intermediaries and fiduciaries (Schedule C-type code), and recognises specific exceptions such as exercise of stock options.
